class.name: SteamIntResult
class.brief_description: The outcome and typed value of a cached Steam integer stat read.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the cached integer on success or zero on failure. Check [member SteamResult.ok] to distinguish the outcomes.

members.member: Signed 32-bit Steam stat value widened to a Godot integer. Meaningful when [member SteamResult.ok] is true. Zero is also the fallback for a failed read.
